title: cistus paui
intro: Cistus paui, commonly known as the Mallorcan or Spanish rockrose, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions, including fever and infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, calm the nervous system, and act as an expectorant, making it a popular remedy for respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents present in Cistus paui include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
